prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1022; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other driver was changing lanes. Complaints centered on right shoulder pain and limited range of motion, which the history indicates is consistent with the mechanism and force of the impact. Over five visits, treatment followed a conventional course of assessment, anti-inflammatory medication, a supervised home exercise program, and progressive mobility work. Examination revealed tenderness and pain with overhead reach that supports the reported injury, while several other orthopedic and neurological screening tests returned normal results. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder. Symptoms improved steadily with care, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as function returned. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated or repeated entries. At discharge from active care, the patient was advised to continue the home program and to return if symptoms recur.
